name: hud_ui_background_cursor_widget_set_pos
description: HudUiBackgroundCursorWidget::SetPos delegates to HudUiWidget::SetPos and then rebuilds the captured background image from the widget's resolved x/y coordinates.
tier_s_evidence: Binary Ninja for 0x4bfb70 shows HudUiWidget::SetPos(self, x, y), then reloads self->x and self->y from offsets 0x14 and 0x18 before calling HudUiBackgroundCursorWidget::CaptureBackgroundUnderCursorImage.

The native smoke sets center-alignment on the cursor image and verifies SetPos(4, 3) stores x=3/y=2, captures the software-surface rectangle at that resolved position, and updates the cursor blit source and clip rect.
